property_summary: For any address that has not called lockInGuess, a direct call to settle() must revert (both stored block and guess remain zero in the reference, so the block-guard rejects it); the mutant only checks the guess, so an empty-zero guess caller can reach settlement and succeed, violating the universal 'unlocked address settle() reverts' rule.
change_summary: Weaken the first settle guard so it only checks the stored guess, not the block field, allowing settlement of a zero-block guess and causing a different revert/success path.
